data.narrative:
Hypersonix Launch Systems is a Series A defense & security company that has raised $46M AUD to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 same-sector companies at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 8 private entities and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, which establish the competitive landscape for frontier-stage defense technology.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $46M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $92M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company cohort produces a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The peer set includes five sampled companies: Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B, Series B), Code Metal ($1.2B, Series B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B, Series B).

The triangulated valuation range is $78M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $546M. The wide dispersion reflects stage and maturity variance within the peer cohort; Series B peers command substantially higher valuations than Series A entrants. Key uncertainties include Hypersonix's technical differentiation relative to Anduril and Shield AI, capital efficiency trajectory, and customer concentration in government contracting.
